name: gleif-mcp-server
description: Access the Global Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) database for company verification, KYC, and corporate ownership research via GLEIF's public API.

tools.name: lei_lookup
tools.description: Get full details for a specific LEI (Legal Entity Identifier)

tools.name: validate_lei
tools.description: Check if an LEI code is valid (format, check digits, status)

tools.name: batch_lei_lookup
tools.description: Look up multiple LEI records in one request (max 100)

tools.name: search_entity
tools.description: Search for legal entities by name with pagination

tools.name: search_by_bic
tools.description: Find LEI from a bank's BIC/SWIFT code

tools.name: search_by_isin
tools.description: Find the issuer's LEI from a securities ISIN code

tools.name: search_by_country
tools.description: Find entities registered in a specific country

tools.name: get_relationships
tools.description: Get corporate ownership and fund relationships for an entity

tools.name: autocomplete
tools.description: Get entity name suggestions as user types

tools.name: get_lei_issuer
tools.description: Get details about an LEI issuer (LOU)

tools.name: get_reporting_exceptions
tools.description: Get Level 2 reporting exceptions for an entity
